prompt:
Use case: isolated industrial-equipment component reconstruction
Asset type: one standalone reusable transparent PNG component for an editable industrial process diagram.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved full-slide concept; use it for the target machine's placement, silhouette, viewing angle, palette and lighting. Image 2 is the earlier transparent group of five equipment illustrations; use it only to clarify construction details of the production machine. It is reference material, not deliverable artwork.
Primary request: Reconstruct exactly one independent production machine/line from the references.
Subject: the upper-center production unit only: a wide stainless-steel enclosed process line with long rectangular front panels, tall transparent inspection windows showing restrained warm-lit machinery inside, small valves and pipe fittings attached to the top, and the short foreground conveyor table with metal rollers and a dark support frame. The enclosure and its front conveyor are one production-line assembly. Preserve the compact overall footprint and the source's low frontal three-quarter view.
Style/medium: polished realistic industrial concept illustration, reflective brushed silver, fine dark seams, restrained amber interior light, small bolts and rollers, crisp high-detail metal rendering matching Image 1 and Image 2.
Composition/framing: show this complete one-machine assembly centered, upright, uncropped, and with generous transparent padding. Keep its natural wide proportions; do not add a second production cell.
Lighting: neutral overhead highlights on steel with a subtle warm glow inside the inspection windows, all attached to the machinery.
Constraints: genuine transparent RGBA outside the production machine. Keep the transparent conveyor windows transparent/glass-like as appropriate and do not fill them with text or symbols. Small fittings that physically belong to this line remain attached; external process pipes do not.
Avoid: the heating furnace, exhaust tower, vessel/pump, heat exchanger, any connector pipe that bridges toward another device, long orange/teal process routes, glows, arrowheads, labels, badges, text, room, background, grid, floor plane, detached shadow, frame, border, watermark, cropped conveyor or changed viewpoint.

input_references.role: approved full-slide layout, proportions, style and target visual

review: Agent visual review pending final contact-sheet assembly; one production enclosure and attached conveyor only, no neighboring unit, text or shared flow paths.
